key_insight: SDF-SSQP combines derivative-free constrained stochastic optimization with online statistical inference at O((d+m)^2) per-iteration cost.
engineering_relevance: The method targets large-scale nonlinear equality-constrained problems where derivatives are unavailable or costly, with d decision variables and m constraints.
method: Use randomized sketching in derivative-free stochastic sequential quadratic programming.
Establish asymptotic normality for averaged primal–dual iterates.
Apply random scaling for self-normalized inference without explicit covariance estimation or matrix inversion.
evidence_signal: Numerical experiments report effective optimization and accurate statistical inference, but the abstract gives no benchmarks or quantitative results.
watch_item: Inference guarantees are asymptotic; finite-sample reliability and sensitivity to sketching and zeroth-order approximation choices require evaluation.
paper_title: Online Statistical Inference for Derivative-Free Constrained Stochastic Optimization
